records.name: h
cells: Metered infrastructure — passed through at cost + 30%

Usage beyond your plan’s included storage, bandwidth, and form submissions is metered monthly at our actual provider cost (Firebase + Vercel) plus a flat 30% — no hidden markup, itemized on every invoice.

Online payments run on Stripe; Aglyn’s transaction fee (see the comparison table) applies on top of Stripe’s processing fees. Dataset storage over your included amount is billed separately at $0.25 / GB-mo.

records.name: qa
cells: Is there really a free plan?
Yes — the Free plan gives you one site, with the Besigner builder, forms, and media included. No credit card required.

records.name: qa
cells: Both. Annual is billed once up front and saves up to ~35% versus paying monthly. Switch anytime from the console.

records.name: qa
cells: What happens if I exceed a plan limit?
You’re not cut off. Extra sites, seats, datasets, storage, and API calls are metered at the rates in the usage table and itemized on your invoice.

records.name: qa
cells: Payments run on Stripe. Aglyn adds a transaction fee on top of Stripe’s processing — 0–5% depending on plan and digital vs. physical goods. It steps down as you move up — 1% on Scale, 0% from Advanced up.

records.name: qa
cells: Can I self-host instead of subscribing?
Yes. Aglyn is Apache-2.0 — run it yourself with Docker and your own Firebase project (see the self-hosting guide), or use the hosted platform and skip the ops.

records.name: qa
cells: Can I change or cancel anytime?
Upgrade, downgrade, or cancel whenever you like from the billing page. Plan changes prorate automatically.

records.name: qa
cells: Apply it at checkout — promotion codes work on any paid plan and show up itemized on your invoice.

records.name: qa
cells: Do you offer SSO or an SLA?
Both are coming for Enterprise contracts: SAML / OIDC single sign-on, an uptime SLA with a public status page, and priority support. Contact sales to plan around them.
